title: Kyu Nai Aunday Meray Veer Pyaare Nana
body:
Main Haan Beemar Tay Karbal Da, Safar Door Bara,
Menu Dus Day, Main Jeewa Kisday Saharay Nana.
<<DIVIDER>>
Kabar-e-Rasool Tay, Beemar Kehndi Si,
Ik Khawab Wekh Kay Main Nana Daar Gaiyan.
Main Jina Wastay Saawa Nu, Dakh Kay Beti Saah
Oh Meray Veer Gaye Karbal’ch Maaray Nana.
<<DIVIDER>>
Akbar Nay Aakhiya, Si Jaan Toh Pehla,
Shagna Day Wehlay Kol Main Bhulawa Ga.
Bhen Nikli Hoyi Sughra Nu, Aa Dasaa Kiway,
Dukh Veera Di Judayi Day, Saharay Nana.
<<DIVIDER>>
Qasid Day Ra Hi Rokay Teri Sughra Nay,
Pegham Karbala Day Pasay Galya Eh.
Jehray Wehlay Da Ali Akbar Chad Kay Turiya Ay,
Us Din Eeyo Di Sughra Beemar Eh Nana.
<<DIVIDER>>
Babay Di Man Kay Veet Turr Paya Ronda,
Chawan Day Naal Jis Nu Main Khidona Si.
La Kay Asghar Nu Galay Rondhi Tay Kurlohndi Rayhi
Jaan Lay Kafila Jad Hoya Tayaar Eh Nana.
<<DIVIDER>>
Akhtar Yaqeen Hai Kay Paak Sughra Nay,
Roz-e-Hashar Nu Rokay Eho Kehna Hai.
Jo Meray Veer Ali Akbar Nu Jagh Tay Rondhe San,
Jaan-o-Khuld Day Wich Saray Day Saray Nana.
